messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — onboarding webhook failures started ~09:12 UTC affecting ~120 trial tenants in EU. Working on a customer note, translations, and an office-hours offer. Need owners for outreach and confirmation on credits.
Sam (Solutions): Saw alerts. Thanks Maria. ETA for fix?
Diego (Eng): Root cause looks like a regression in the retry debounce in the ingest worker from last night's rollout. Reverted the change and pushed a hotfix. Monitoring now.
DeployBot: Hotfix deploy started: deploy/ingest-worker-v2.1.1 → prod (eu). Status: in_progress
Diego (Eng): If deploy goes green in 15–20m we can start backfills for queued webhooks. Estimated full recovery 45–90m depending on backlog size.
Priya (Support): Can we get a short customer-facing status line + a slightly longer RCA draft? I'll push to Intercom and our CS templates.
Maria (CS): Draft short update: "We experienced failures delivering webhook-based onboarding events for some EU trial customers earlier today. Our engineers deployed a fix and deliveries are resuming. We're running backfills and will follow up with an RCA." Link to incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/4861023456
Elena (Translations): I can translate that into Spanish and Japanese. ETA ~30m for both. Any phrasing constraints?
Sam (Solutions): Please add mitigation offer: "We're offering a complimentary billing credit equivalent to one month of standard onboarding throughput for affected tenants, and a dedicated office hours slot tomorrow 14:00 UTC for hands-on help." Good to include?
Maria (CS): Keep the credit phrasing generic. Legal already okayed the wording yesterday for similar incidents.
Priya (Support): Legal confirmed. Add office-hours sign-up link: https://cal.com/redwood-onboard-help and I'll include it in the Intercom template.
Diego (Eng): For RCA TL;DR please include: "A retry debounce regression caused webhook errors to be suppressed instead of queued, creating backpressure and missed deliveries. Fix: revert + enforce queueing + add synthetic backpressure tests."
Sam (Solutions): For high-touch customers I'll send customized messages with impacted windows and offer a live walkthrough. Maria — can you share the affected-tenant list with owners?
Maria (CS): Uploaded CSV here: https://drive.redwood.ai/incident/4861023456/tenants.csv — contains owner emails and contract tier.
Priya (Support): I'll start proactive Intercom messages to high-touch tenants once we have the final copy. Who approves final copy in 15m?
Elena (Translations): Spanish draft: "Hemos tenido problemas entregando eventos de webhook durante el proceso de incorporación para algunos clientes en la región EU. Nuestros ingenieros han desplegado una corrección y las entregas se están reanudando. Estamos ejecutando procesos de reenvío y compartiremos un informe detallado pronto."
Elena (Translations): Japanese draft: "一部のEUリージョンのお客さまにおいて、オンボーディング中のWebhook配信に障害が発生しました。エンジニアが修正をデプロイし、配信は再開しています。現在バックフィルを実施しており、追って詳細なRCAを共有します。"
Maria (CS): Looks good. Priya — want to own send? I'll approve copies.
Priya (Support): I will send the short update to impacted segments when DeployBot reports green.
DeployBot: Hotfix deploy succeeded in EU. All ingesters healthy. Post-deploy smoke: ok.
Diego (Eng): Backfills started. We're rate-limiting to avoid downstream spikes; expect 6–8 hours to clear backlog for largest tenants, most will be caught up within 2–3 hours.
Sam (Solutions): I'll update the enablement doc and add a short KB on how to surface missing webhook events for customers. Link will be pasted in thread.
Maria (CS): Final checklist for publish: translations attached, Intercom template set, office hours cal link added, billing credit PR queued. Diego — RCA doc draft assigned to you. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
Priya (Support): I'll post the Intercom message now and queue follow-ups for customers who respond requesting help.
Sam (Solutions): For renewal-risk monitoring — flag any tenants with onboarding >48h delay and loop in CSMs; I'll create a report.
Maria (CS): Good call. We'll include renewal-risk flags in the customer follow-up and offer extended onboarding support where needed.
Diego (Eng): After-action items: add synthetic backpressure tests, stricter canary on retry logic, and a dashboard alert for suppressed-queue incidents.
Maria (CS): Closing thread — will post RCA link here once Diego's draft is ready. Thanks everyone.
